finding_key: packages/frontend/src/lib/date-format-preference.ts::unguarded `localstorage.getitem` in `getdateformat` is called as the `usesyncexternalstore` snapshot on every render of the documents list and settings page; a storage securityerror takes the whole list down
evidence: Verified against the supplied source: getDateFormat (date-format-preference.ts:31–34) does an unguarded localStorage.getItem and is used as the useSyncExternalStore snapshot (lines 56–58), executing during render of DateCell (document-list.tsx) and Settings (page.tsx:26). localStorage property access genuinely throws SecurityError in blocked-storage/sandboxed-iframe contexts (though the Safari-private-mode example is outdated), and no error boundary is visible, so a throw would crash the list. The defect is real but confined to restricted-storage environments; I could not verify the reviewer's claim that all other localStorage reads in the repo are guarded (no checkout available), so severity is judged minor rather than major.
